p.text: Chief, the officer makes the ship go. I make the men go. Which one is more important?
A ship is happy or unhappy in one place. Not on the bridge. Not in the engine room. In the galley. Bad food, bad ship.

p.text: The engine eats fuel. The men eat rice.
The chief and Danilo were on their knees for five hours. Eat. And say thank you.
Chief. My son is an engineer, like you. I hope he's not stupid like you.

p.text: Today the sea tried to take one of my men. So tonight I feed all of them. The sea can have the ocean. The table is mine.
